name: Shabab Al Bomb
description: A fast-paced comedy that follows a group of friends navigating life, love, and family drama in hilarious and unexpected ways, capturing the ups and downs of youth in modern Saudi Arabia.

videos.title: Al-Mandoob
videos.overview: Amer and his friends explore the world of delivery services after one of their group is hospitalized with food poisoning from a delivery meal. Upon discovering the risks and hardships delivery workers face daily, Amer attempts to lead a "revolution" to organize the representatives and tackle the chaotic demands of the gig economy.
